# Beatwick

> Every city has a sound. Beatwick maps the music of 30 cities — the scenes, the venues, the tracks actually moving — with auto-updating playlists and writing with teeth.

- URL: https://beatwick.com/
- Feed: https://beatwick.com/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://beatwick.com/sitemap.xml

## What this is

An international music-discovery platform organized by city. Each of the 30 cities gets a page with a scene thesis, an auto-updating Spotify playlist (embedded via `<!-- SPOTIFY-PLAYLIST: beatwick-<slug> -->` markers), a trending-tracks list, real venues, and scene-report dispatches. The editorial stance: sharp, funny, factual — punchy ledes, specific details, a clear take, never dry recaps.

## Structure

- `/` — homepage: hero, "Loud This Week" leaderboard, 30-city grid, latest dispatches, newsletter band
- `/cities/` — full 30-city directory grouped by region
- `/cities/<slug>.html` — per-city pages (playlist embed marker, trending tracks, venues, dispatches)
- `/articles/` — flagship scene reports (600-900 words)
- `/about.html` — brand manifesto

## Regions

North America: New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, Montreal, Nashville, Atlanta, New Orleans
Latin America & Caribbean: São Paulo, Mexico City, Bogotá, Buenos Aires, Kingston
Europe: London, Berlin, Paris, Amsterdam, Barcelona, Lisbon, Stockholm, Glasgow
Africa & Middle East: Lagos, Johannesburg, Accra, Cairo
Asia-Pacific: Tokyo, Seoul, Mumbai, Jakarta, Manila, Melbourne
